integrity: The fixed locus is obtained by solving the source's four linear exponent-duality equations. The negative-norming index is reconstructed directly from the source sign configurations, and the central tau-zero multiplicity follows from the complete factored tau product. The primary source was inspected at each of these formulas; no numerical experiment is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns equality with the ordered Askey--Wilson dual parameter quadruple in the canonical discrete chamber. It does not classify duality only up to the source's parameter permutations or Weyl-group reflections, and it does not assert that every tau zero produces an uncancelled pole for every spectral parameter.
title: Ordered self-duality forces indefinite Toda data in the elementary Askey–Wilson family
